sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether public employers may force nonunion staff to fund union legal work outside their specific bargaining unit.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case want the Court to ban compelled fees for external legal defense.
the opposing sides want the Court to allow unions to charge for all legal services.
